decisive_items: Space-occupying lesion at left epidural site of T2-3
T1WI and T2FS sequences showed high signals
response.rationale: Pathological examination definitively confirms a vascular malformation; the epidural lesion and spinal compression are its consequences. R1 adds unsupported arteriovenous specificity, while R2/R4 are not supported by pathology.

rejected.why: Arteriovenous malformation is a specific subtype not established by the pathology report, which only confirms vascular malformation.
Spinal epidural hematoma is not the confirmed pathology; the lesion is pathologically a vascular malformation, and no anticoagulation/coagulopathy is present.
Epidural abscess is contradicted by pathological confirmation of vascular malformation and lacks infectious/clinical support.
